Wide panoramic 16:9 composition. This is one independent distant layer, NOT a full game scene. OPAQUE image all the way to all edges. Main 80% of image is a quiet deep desaturated blue evening sky, narrow warm pale-gold dusk band near 75% height, few long quiet cloud wisps with crisp clustered pixel edges. Bottom 20% holds low, extremely distant rolling meadow horizons in soft slate blue, tiny isolated bell spires barely perceptible, no recognizable foreground. Near-black silhouettes with a few thin moss and honey pixels in anchor; use that economy, not photoreal texture. Large quiet color masses, only 5 to 7 softly separated color steps. Open windy PLAINS, not cave or dense forest. Keep left and right horizon height/color identical for lateral repetition and avoid large landmarks near edges. NO ground platforms, trees up close, UI, words, characters, foreground framing, giant moon, gradient banding or black border. Designed at small logical pixel resolution, crisp edges, sparse texture.
